## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or contributors. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Explain any checks that do not apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests and the build pass, or I explained why a check does not apply.
- [ ] Messaging routes and readiness claims match verified behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private messages, runtime databases, or receiver checkpoints are included.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, and documentation changes are covered where applicable.
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/newbiesitl/paprika-messenger/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/newbiesitl/paprika-messenger/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Changes to `main` require the owner's code review. The owner may merge through the documented review exception after self-review; CI and the other branch protections still apply.
